$comment: GENERATED by scripts/contracts-generate.mjs from packages/api/src/api.ts; do not edit.

deadline.description: the wait ends then: step fails with 'timeout', verdict 'no-submission' for presentation

text.description: inline up to 64 KiB in events; up to 256 KiB (the stored cap) in API-27 (ADR-37)

BodyState.description: 'none': no body; 'stored': `body` present; 'pruned': deleted by retention; 'dropped_run_cap': per-run budget exhausted (05 §4.3, §5)

CapturedMessage.description: one HTTP exchange (request + response, request + error)

error.description: exactly one of response / error is set

exchangeIds.description: the captured exchanges the check rests on

outcome.description:
'info' = informational, never a pass criterion, never a fail criterion, never counted in
`stepSummary`, never counted in a verdict (first user: `vp.wallet.verifier-badges`, 03 FLOW-60, S-203)

specClause.description: spec name + section title (P7 owns tamper clauses)

tamper.description: present only on the single verdict.check of a tamper run (07 §6; 04 §3.5)

findings.description: 'code-drift' is the only value defined today

reason.description: for 'inconclusive' and 'fail' (for example 'control run failed', '5xx where 4xx required')

relation.description: 'derived' = child.parentRunId = parent; 'control-tamper' = tamper run vs its control

disclosure.description: default: 03 §2.0 DCQL claim of the format

knobs.description: omitted knobs take defaults; keys not belonging to a chosen adapter: knob_invalid

preset.description: preset ID of API-07; applied before explicit knobs

skipIncompatible.description: true: drop incompatible cells and list them in `skipped`; false: reject the request

EngineOpOutputSummaries.description: Typed `outputSummary` of the engine ops the UI and fingerprints rely on (04 §7.2 table).

details.description: free-form, per error code (04 §6.2); its own shape, not KnobValues (G-139)

message.description: English, one sentence, safe to show; never secrets, never stack traces

payload.description: P8 addition to 02 §4.2: run list updates (02 §4.3)

grant.description: null when the run has no such step (credential-level verification, issuance-only; 05 §3 `cell_key` writes '-')

coverageNote.description: names the hop outside capture when capture = 'partial'

title.description: the fingerprint's one-line title (09 A2 `title`), copied so history replay needs no library

extends.description: format-delta files: start from the base steps, replace by stepKey, append after `after`

lifelines.description: issuance: IUI, I, W, L; presentation: VUI, V, W, L (03 §3.1)

targetStepKey.description: the step whose outcome is the run outcome (05 §4.1)

after.description: only in an `extends` file: stepKey to insert this step after

deprecated.description: kept one release so old runs render (03 §3.1 rule 5)

label.description: arrow text shown in the diagram

messages.description: 2 for http (request + dashed response), 1 for engine/ui/manual (03 §3.1)

skipReason.description: text of `step.completed.skipReason` when the filter does not match; default "not applicable"

Headers.description: Header list, order and duplicates preserved; each entry is [name, value].

privateDisclosure.description: drafts for private-disclosure gaps are never created (09 A9.6)

IssueDraftChecklist.description: 08: the five human checks (the fifth matters for tamper-derived drafts, RISK-27)

IssueDraftPatch.description:
'pending' cannot be set again; 'approved' needs `checklist` with all five true (else 422
`validation_failed`); 'filed-by-human' needs `filedUrl` (https URL the user pasted after filing by hand)

formats.description: the knob is offered only for these formats

KnobValues.description: Every knob of every chosen adapter, explicit (04 §11 KnobValues).

runDeleted.description: snapshots only: the referenced run was pruned, deleted ("run pruned" in the UI)

env.run-list.description: P8 addition to 02 §4.2: run list updates (02 §4.3)

grant.description: null when the run has no such step (credential-level verification, issuance-only; 05 §3 `cell_key` writes '-')

coverageNote.description: names the hop outside capture when capture = 'partial'

PollInfo.description: 04 §8.3; total only on the group's last persisted response

eventCount.description: last seq of the run stream

heavyPrunedAt.description: `runs.heavy_pruned_at` (05 §3, §8.2): when retention deleted the bodies and heavy artifacts

pinned.description: API-36; the only mutable fields after the terminal event

uiDriven.description: true for verifier.inji-verify-sdk (steps arrive through API-55)

RunErrorCode.description: Run-level values of `Run.errorCode` beyond the HTTP table (04 §6.2 closing paragraph).

version.description: a version label; with `versionRole` only that role, else any role (05 `run_versions`)

RunPatch.description: API-36; at least one field; note ≤ 2,000 chars

grant.description: null when the run has no such step (as `RunSpec.grant`; ADR-81)

mode.description: null for issuance-only and credential-level runs (as `RunSpec.presentationMode`; ADR-81)

findings.description: 'code-drift' is the only value defined today

reason.description: for 'inconclusive' and 'fail' (for example 'control run failed', '5xx where 4xx required')

RunSpec.description: Immutable (ADR-21); 02 §1.3 names first, P8 additions after.

clientIdScheme.description: effective scheme; = KNOB-07 value, except 'redirect_uri' for wallet.inji-mobile

env.description: keyed by role; derived from the adapter descriptors

grant.description: null when the run has no such step (credential-level verification, issuance-only; 05 §3 `cell_key` writes '-')

knobs.description: every knob of every chosen adapter, explicit

scope.description: 'issuance' stops after the issuance flow; the verifier is still recorded

tunnelHost.description: set when the tunnel base URLs were switched at creation (02 §2.6)

versions.description: keyed by role; Availability.versionFingerprint at creation

withIae.description: FLOW-13; only when the probe allows (ADR-50)

countsTowardPassRate.description: true only for kind 'interop' with outcome 'pass' | 'fail' | 'blocked' and evidence tier not 'manual'

issuanceOk.description: IssuanceOutcome.ok; null for fixture runs and credential-level-only runs

outcome.description: 'blocked' (05 §4.1): the target step was skipped after an earlier step failed

artifactIds.description: artifacts of this step in `seq` order; ids stay listed after a heavy prune (API-28 then answers `gone`)

StreamEndFrame.description: The SSE control frame that closes a stream (04 §7.1); it has no `id`.

StreamQuery.description: json: limit 1–1000, default 500; type = comma list

grant.description: null when the run has no such step (credential-level verification, issuance-only; 05 §3 `cell_key` writes '-')

TamperBaselineConfirm.description: identifies the candidate row (05 key: tmp_id, adapter_id, version_label, code)

VciPendingResponse.description: pass `next` as the next `after`; empty list after 25 s

VersionItem.description: one row per (role, component, version_label) of 05 `run_versions`

VersionListResponse.description: not paged; ordered by `lastUsedAt` descending; cap 200 rows

VpResponseResponse.description: the BFF posts it through CapturingHttp (S-182)
